data.description: 罗德岛深层心理观测室，单向玻璃反射出幽暗暖黄的台灯光泽。倒坐在转椅上，下巴搁在椅背顶端，萨卡兹小角在红发间微耸，修长指节托着下巴，眼神充满看穿心绪的狡黠。 她微微抬眸轻语——“你的恐惧、心跳还有欲望……在我的视野里就像写在脸上的密文一样清晰哦。不用装傻啦，博士。”
data.promptProse: Nymph sits backwards in a leather swivel chair in the Rhodes Island counseling observation office, resting her chin on the chair back with a perceptive smirk. A single warm desk lamp casts playful highlights across her features in the dim, private room.
data.animaCaption: Resting her chin on the back of a swivel chair, she flashes a perceptive, playful smirk.
